title: Add customer sales-invoice evidence register
description: Add a customer sales-invoice evidence register for ordinary, special VAT and export invoice records, with explicit allocations to existing Sales Orders. Keep these accounting or tax invoice records distinct from Trade Document Commercial Invoices and do not issue an invoice, submit to a tax platform, infer order links, post accounts receivable, execute production SQL, deploy, or release.
acceptance_criteria: Users can create and edit draft customer sales-invoice evidence with invoice type, invoice code when applicable, invoice number, invoice date, Customer, currency, net amount, tax amount, gross amount and bounded notes.

The server validates documented amount equations and currency precision and validates the authoritative Customer; missing, deleted or inactive Customers are rejected for new records while bounded Customer snapshots are preserved for historical reads.
Active invoice identity is unique for the same Customer, invoice type and normalized code/number combination; duplicates are rejected rather than silently merged.

A draft invoice can allocate all or part of its gross amount to one or more existing non-cancelled Sales Orders only when Customer and currency match authoritatively; duplicate order links and allocations above invoice gross amount are rejected.
The invoice displays linked and unlinked amounts explicitly and may remain partially or wholly unlinked without matching a Sales Order from free text, number, date or amount similarity.

Trade Document Commercial Invoices remain a separate export-document snapshot; the new register does not convert, replace or silently link them, and any explicit cross-reference is treated only as bounded evidence.
Users can record a draft invoice and later void it while preserving its identity, amounts, allocations and audit history; recorded or voided evidence is not hard-deleted or silently rewritten.

Recording or voiding an invoice does not issue or cancel a real invoice, call a tax service, change Sales Order status, shipment progress, receipt allocations, Customer credit state, commissions, inventory or finance records.
Existing Customers, Sales Orders and Trade Documents remain valid without sales-invoice rows; no request-time or production backfill is performed.
Repository schema changes are idempotent, normal queries are bounded or paged and avoid per-row database access, and validation runs only through permitted local or test-database paths.

Unit/integration tests cover supported invoice types, amount validation, duplicate identity, invalid Customer, compatible order allocation, Customer/currency mismatch, partial linkage, void history, Trade Document separation and source-record non-mutation; safe validation passes and browser acceptance is recorded as deferred during development.

scenarios: Create a customer sales-invoice evidence record, allocate it partially across compatible Sales Orders and verify linked and unlinked amounts persist without changing the orders or issuing a real invoice.

Attempt a duplicate invoice and a mismatched Customer or currency allocation, verify both are rejected, then void a recorded invoice and verify its evidence remains readable and distinct from Trade Document Commercial Invoices.

human_gate.reason: Repository invoice evidence and non-production test schema only. Real invoice issuance, tax-platform access, production database execution, accounting posting, deployment and release remain behind mandatory human gates.
